title: Lemongrass Tagine Stew
description: A rich and flavorful vegan stew inspired by North African cuisine, made with lemongrass and a blend of spices.

ingredients.name: algerian
ingredients.notes: use ras el hanout spice blend

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic; cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add carrots and potatoes; cook for 5 minutes.
Add lemongrass, cumin, coriander, and salt; stir to combine.
Add coconut milk and stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Season with ras el hanout spice blend to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh lemongrass leaves, if desired.
